notes_for_editor: Thin record. Unresolved: (a) county, Lyon per the NHLR versus Trigg per the Forest Lookouts header; (b) build year, 1930 per the NHLR Built field versus 'in the 1930s' in the NHLR description. A search snippet from an onX trail page (not opened, not cited) says the CCC built it around 1937. (c) No page read gives staffing, access or current condition. The 'standing' status rests only on the present-tense NHLR description. Wildland #2 (US 1744, KY 5) is a different, relocated tower; do not merge the two records. A 2020 Library of Congress photo of a Land Between the Lakes fire tower in Trigg County came up in search; its identity with this tower is unconfirmed, so no photo was added.
